shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!*lock*'"' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'index.html' -g '*config*' -g '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/**'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,90p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -A 12 -B 3 '### .*(@gravity-ui/(table|navigation|uikit|icons))' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; rg -n -A 22 '"'^## (Table|Navigation|Icons)'"' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; ls -a"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/navigation @gravity-ui/table @gravity-ui/icons'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md; rg -n 'brand|--g-color.*(positive|info|utility)|--g-spacing' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -65"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/package.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json | head -130; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/README.md; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md | head -70; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/table node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation | rg '(docs/INDEX|\\.d.ts"'$)'"' | head -65"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/INDEX.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | head -190; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/Table/Table.d.ts; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm | rg '(useRowSelectionFixedHandler|useTable|ColumnReorderingProvider).*d.ts"'$'"'; node -e \"for(const p of ['uikit','navigation','table','icons']) {let j=require('@gravity-ui/'+p+'/package.json');console.log(p,j.version,j.peerDependencies)}\""

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | rg '/(Select|TextInput|Modal|Button|Checkbox|DropdownMenu|Text)/.*d.ts"'$'"' | head -35; rg '"'^export.*(House|Persons|Bag|Gear|Bell|Magnifier|ArrowDown|ArrowUp|Plus|Chevron|Sliders|Layout|CircleQuestion|ArrowRight|Ellipsis|Check|Clock|Xmark|Bars|Receipt|Cube|Calendar|Envelope)'"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -65; curl -Ls https://gravity-ui.com/icons -o /tmp/gravity-icons.html; wc -c /tmp/gravity-icons.html"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"for(const p of ['uikit','navigation','table','icons']) {let j=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/'+p+'/package.json');console.log(p,j.version,j.peerDependencies)}\"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/hooks/useTable.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/ColumnReorderingProvider/types.d.ts; rg -n -A 45 'CSS API' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md; rg -n -A 35 'interface (LogoProps|MenuItem)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head -90; rg -n 'onUpdate|options\\??:|value\\??:|label\\??:|renderControl|placeholder|className|size\\??:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts | head -70; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/Table/Table.css | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.d.ts | head -140; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm | rg 'TextInput.*d.ts"'$'"'; rg -n 'onUpdate|startContent|endContent|type\\??:|errorMessage' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/types.d.ts; rg -n 'export.*(House|Persons|ShoppingBag|Gear|Magnifier|CircleQuestion|LayoutColumns|Sliders|Receipt|Cube|CircleCheck|Clock|CircleXmark|Ellipsis|Layers|ArrowDownToLine|ChartLine|ArrowUpRight)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts; cat tsconfig.json; rg -n 'renderGroupHeader|selectionColumn' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.js | head -25; rg -n 'export.*configure' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head -95; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseGroupHeader/BaseGroupHeader.d.ts | head -80; rg -n 'base-utility|text-light-solid|base-positive|base-info' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/_colors.scss | head -25; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/types/base.d.ts | head -65; rg -n 'className|view\\??|title\\??|type\\??' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/hooks/useTable.js; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseGroupHeader/BaseGroupHeader.js; rg -n -A 18 'getIsGroupHeaderRow|renderGroupHeaderRowContent' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/hooks/useRowContent.js; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | head -75; cat index.html; git diff --stat; npm ls --depth=0"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -o -- '--g-color-(text-(light|inverted)[a-z-]*|base-utility[a-z-]*):["'^;}]+'"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -25; sed -n '1,155p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/utils/getRowContent.js; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler.js | head -95; git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/Table/Table.js; rg -n 'getIsGroupHeaderRow' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.js; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.css | head -55; cat .gitignore"
